profile.runtime: IWER Meta Quest 3 browser emulation (managed headless Chromium)
profile.input: hand rays + pinches with either hand, and index-fingertip presses (poke) on the touch tray; both controllers disconnected
profile.rendering: SwiftShader software WebGL on a shared 4-CPU host; frame timings are not representative of a Quest
profile.menuPinchView: While the menu is shown (Home, its pause view), the emulated head looks almost straight down (88 degrees) during each pinch so the 80k-triangle hero and the menu atmosphere leave the view and software frames stay inside the 800 ms click window; the ray, hit test and pinch are unchanged. Legacy pinches use a level view; tray presses look down at the tray.

emulationSetup.note: Software-emulation accommodation only: a 640x480 managed viewport, Quest Render Quality Low and Ambient Motion Off, and the short visit marked complete so entry opens Home.

checks: Active immersive session with required hand tracking, both controllers disconnected
Home is interactive with no My Legacy chunk or panel document requested (the Legacy panels do not exist yet)
Home -> My Legacy loads its chunk and panels on this first entry (5333 ms in the development server), then hides the menu, sorcerer and atmosphere; environment: standin
The reading panel sits from 11.7 to -19.3 degrees at 1.40 m; the touch tray is 0.60 m from the eye at -47.4 degrees
A fingertip press on the touch tray, 0.61 m from the eye, presses the founding step's Continue

Founding with pinches from either hand: nation, Other names, the keyboard typed then cancelled, suggested name "Keepers of the Umbra", preset and per-element arms, motto "We hold" typed, raised; the raising beat continued by a fingertip press; save: saved
Every landmark opens by pointing at it in the holding with the right hand and pinching (environment hover and select callbacks)
Every landmark also opens from the landmark list with the left hand; the War Record's three sections list open matters, the ledger and (honestly empty) conflicts
Nomination: Lucien on the a-file, shown in the Muster ledger and the formation, and saved
The rival challenge states its wager as four terms, repeated on Accept; confirming shows "Awaiting the board", with no match played or recorded
A left fingertip press on the tray's Back (0.61 m from the eye) returns to the Herald's Station
Losing both hands pauses My Legacy; a returning hand enables Resume, which restores the exact Legacy view and state
The tray's Pause (pinched) pauses My Legacy, and the pause view's Return to Home (pinched) goes Home
Recenter moves the Legacy anchor, panel and tray in front of the current view; the viewer pose is only ever set by the test, never by the app
Exit VR ends the immersive session from the tray; re-entry returns to the same Legacy place
The banner, motto, nomination and accepted challenge are written to crownfall.legacy.save in this browser
After a page reload the saved banner, nomination and accepted challenge load from storage, and the tray says so

entry.note: Development server (unbundled modules): the first-entry load time is not the production figure.

limitations: Browser emulation is not physical Quest validation: tracking quality, comfort, reach for a particular body, cold start and GPU frame pacing are unmeasured.
The emulated fingertip press moves the hand to the control; reach is evidenced by the control's measured distance from the eye, not by a body model.
